aliases: 苹果早期那种真皮缝线效果

description.zh: 用现实世界的材质与物理形态表示数字控件的视觉语言：皮革缝线、木质纹理、拉丝 金属、玻璃光泽，按钮做成可以按压的实体，开关做成拨杆。界面元件拥有高光、 投影与倒角，"看起来像什么"直接暗示"能怎么用"。
description.en: A visual language that borrows real-world materials and physical forms for digital controls: leather stitching, wood grain, brushed metal, glass gloss. Buttons look pressable, switches look like levers — highlights, shadows and bevels make "what it looks like" teach "how it works".

use_when.zh: 用户不熟悉触屏，需要借助现实隐喻降低学习成本
use_when.en: Unfamiliar users who learn controls from real-world metaphors

use_when.zh: 品牌需要复古 怀旧或高端工艺感（音响 咖啡 笔记本应用）
use_when.en: Brands seeking vintage, nostalgic or crafted-premium feel

use_when.zh: 表达物理操作的乐趣，如拨动 按压 旋转
use_when.en: Playful physical interactions — flipping, pressing, turning

avoid_when.zh: 信息密度高的工具类界面，装饰会挤压内容与效率
avoid_when.en: Dense productivity tools where decoration crowds out content

avoid_when.zh: 需要频繁换肤与多平台适配，重度纹理维护成本高
avoid_when.en: Multi-platform products — heavy textures are costly to maintain

avoid_when.zh: 极简品牌语境，拟物会显得过时与俗气
avoid_when.en: Minimal brand contexts where skeuomorphism reads as dated

note.zh: 皮革纹理加缝线描边，早期 iOS 日历 记事本
note.en: Leather grain with stitching — early iOS Calendar and Notes

note.zh: 金属渐变与高光倒角，iTunes 老播放器
note.en: Metal gradients with beveled highlights — classic iTunes

note.zh: 纸张折角与压印文字，iBooks 书架
note.en: Paper corners and embossed type — the iBooks shelf

task.zh: 探索系列与 01/02/03 展示对应商品；搜索好物并检查无匹配结果，查看商品后加入购物袋，调整/移除并查看合计；产品、故事、手工制作、门店均有对应内容，结算不创建真实订单。
task.en: Explore the collection and 01/02/03 show matching objects. Search including no matches, inspect an object and add it to the bag, adjust/remove items and inspect totals. Objects, Stories, Craft and Stores have matching content; checkout creates no real order.

checks.zh: 逐一操作 Daily Goods 原导航和主 CTA，检查对应内容与返回路径，不只是点击提示。
checks.en: Use Daily Goods’s original navigation and primary CTAs; inspect content and return paths, not just click notices.

checks.zh: 完成上述 Daily Goods 操作后修改输入或撤销，检查结果与状态同步。
checks.en: Complete the Daily Goods task, then change inputs or undo and inspect the matching result/state.

checks.zh: 用键盘和 390px / 320px 检查重排、焦点、校验；区分工具栏重载和内部清空，核对刷新后状态复位。
checks.en: Check reflow, focus and validation with keyboard and 390px / 320px viewports; distinguish toolbar reload from in-page clearing and inspect reset-on-reload boundaries.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — Flat Design and Skeuomorphism

notes.zh: 三层立体感：基础材质层（纹理图或细密渐变），顶部 1px 高光内阴影模拟受光 上缘，底部外投影表现厚度。按钮按下时反转内阴影方向制造"压下去"。渐变 范围要窄（3%～8% 明度差），否则像廉价塑料。文字用压印效果：深色投影 1px 加同色 1px 高光。深色模式降低材质明度但保留高光结构。
notes.en: Three depth layers: a material base (texture image or a fine gradient), a 1px inset top highlight for the lit upper edge, and an outer bottom shadow for thickness. On press, flip the inset shadow to feel pushed in. Keep gradient bands narrow (3–8% luminance) or it reads as cheap plastic. Emboss text with a 1px dark shadow plus a 1px same-hue highlight. Dark mode darkens the material but keeps the highlight structure.

basic.zh: 用拟物化风格（Skeuomorphism）设计界面：控件采用真实材质质感——皮革 金属 木材， 按钮有立体按压感，开关像实物拨杆。
basic.en: "Design an interface in Skeuomorphism style: controls rendered in real materials — leather, metal, wood — with pressable dimensional buttons and switch-like toggles."

design.zh: 拟物化设计规范：底色用皮革纹或木纹材质图；按钮为窄幅线性渐变（上下明度差 8% 以内）+ 1px 顶部高光内阴影 + 底部投影；控件圆角 6～10px；文字用压印 效果（1px 深影 + 1px 高光）；缝线用 dashed 描边模拟；按下态反转内阴影并 下移 1px。深色模式整体降明度 20%，高光保留。
design.en: "Skeuomorphism design spec: leather-grain or wood texture backgrounds; buttons with a narrow linear gradient (under 8% luminance swing), 1px inset top highlight and a bottom drop shadow; 6–10px radii; embossed type (1px dark shadow + 1px highlight); dashed borders for stitching; pressed state flips the inset shadow and shifts down 1px. Dark mode drops material luminance ~20% and keeps highlights."

implementation.zh:
以 /styles/skeuomorphism/ 为整页入口。标题表达：THE MATERIAL ARCHIVE；页面气质：让数字操作，有真实的手感。。按最新整页图像提案设计布局、字体、图形、材质与组件；桌面区域构图为 "title title controls" "art art controls" "notes prompt variants"，不能只换颜色。

首页入口固定在左上角，图标加“首页”，点击区域至少 44×44px；手机上不收进菜单。变体只使用 皮革缝线、拉丝金属、纸质，切换同步材质、构图或控件与提示词；保留用户已编辑文字。详情通过原生 dialog 打开，支持 Escape、焦点归还和浏览器前进后退。保留收藏、语言切换、风格指南与可编辑提示词；复制失败选中文本供手动复制。当前风格过渡基准 220ms，减少动态效果时取消动画。桌面、390px、320px 按内容重排。

实现入口为 src/components/atlas/AtlasPage.astro；逐风格顺序在 src/lib/atlas-designs.ts；交互在 src/lib/atlas-runtime.ts；整页样式在 src/styles/atlas-pages.css。既有 /style-scenes/ 独立案例保留，但不要重新嵌入详情页。
implementation.en:
Build the full /en/styles/skeuomorphism/ page. Display direction: THE MATERIAL ARCHIVE; A tangible feeling for digital actions.. Follow the latest whole-page image proposal for layout, typography, artwork, materials and components. Desktop grid areas: "title title controls" "art art controls" "notes prompt variants". Do not just recolour a template.

Keep an icon plus Home link fixed at the top left, at least 44×44px, visible on mobile without opening a menu. Variants: Leather, Brushed Metal, Paper. Update the design and prompt without overwriting manual edits. Native dialogs support Escape, focus return and browser Back/Forward. Preserve saves, locale switching, style guide and editable prompts; select text for manual copy when clipboard access fails. Base transition: 220ms, disabled with reduced motion. Reflow at desktop, 390px and 320px.

Use AtlasPage.astro, atlas-designs.ts, atlas-runtime.ts and atlas-pages.css. Keep the legacy /style-scenes/ examples separate; do not embed them into the detail page.

typography.zh: 系统无衬线，贴近真实印刷

color.zh: 灰铝渐变底 × 蓝色高光

border.zh: 金属描边 + 内侧高光线
border.en: Metal outlines with inner highlight lines

shadow.zh: 外投影 + inset 内高光同时使用

spacing.zh: 控件内边距模拟实物比例

motion.zh: 150–200ms 的按压实感过渡，模拟物理回弹
motion.en: 150–200ms pressed-feel transitions mimicking a physical rebound

states.zh: hover 加深高光；focus 用蓝色发光可见轮廓；active 用 inset 阴影表现按下；disabled 降低对比；error 用红色高光
states.en: Hover deepens the highlight; focus shows a visible blue glow outline; active presses via inset shadow; disabled lowers contrast; error uses a red highlight

keywords.zh: 质感 · 拟真 · 凹凸

heroSub.zh: 像真实物件一样可靠、可触。
heroSub.en: As dependable and tangible as a real object.

heroCaption.zh: 皮革纹理 · 纸张质感 · 金属旋钮
heroCaption.en: Leather textures · Paper surfaces · Metal dials
